## Fix applied — `sklearn/compose/_column_transformer.py` (2 lines, working tree, uncommitted)

**Cause:** `ColumnTransformer.set_output` (line 295–306) built its list of transformers to configure from `chain(self.transformers, self.transformers_)` only — `self.remainder` was never included, so a remainder **estimator** never got `_safe_set_output` and stayed in numpy-output mode, which then broke the pandas-gathering `if` at transform time (the issue's line 853).

```python
if self.remainder not in {"passthrough", "drop"}:
```
